_note: ONE source of truth for PHONE budgets. Read by tools/fx_budget_report.py, tools/qa/phone_report.py (rows with the same key) and tools/qa/phone_forecast.py (docs/146). All PROVISIONAL until measured on a real phone (BD-085).

lights.why: stricter of 24 (docs/126) and 16 (docs/107 s1): dynamic lights are the likeliest low-end phone frame cliff

beams.why: stricter of 48 (docs/126) and 24 (docs/123 T3: 3-4 beams per dino, Lite 6 dinos)

parts.why: docs/107 s1 rule of thumb: parts attached and in range on a 3 GB phone (phone_report.py reads it as the whole workspace, a strict reading)

triangles.why: docs/107 s1 rule of thumb: triangles in the scene

memMb.why: docs/107 s1: total client memory on a 3 GB phone (crashes start near 1.5 GB)

textureMib.why: PROPOSAL (docs/146): about one sixth of the 1,200 MB client rule for ALL decoded images and mesh textures together, counted as RGBA8 before any GPU compression; replace with the Developer Console texture / PlaceMemory reading from BD-085
